title: Kickoff: Disambiguate same app installed from different sources
line: The launcher now labels Flatpak and Snap copies of an app installed twice, like "Firefox (Flatpak)", instead of showing identical entries.
explanation: Kickoff and the other kicker-based launchers showed each installed copy of an app under its plain name, so a distro Firefox, a Flatpak Firefox and a Snap Firefox appeared as three identical entries in categories, All Applications, favorites and search results. Nothing in the menu backend looked at where an app came from. The change adds a helper that reads the X-Flatpak or X-SnapInstanceName key of the desktop file and, only when another visible app has the same name, appends the package format to the shown name (for every name format, and for application search results). The per-name counts are cached and reset whenever the application database changes.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: show the package format of apps installed twice

When the same app was installed from different sources, like distro
packages and Flatpak or Snap, the menu listed identical entries. Now a
Flatpak or Snap app sharing its name with another one shows its format.

BUG: 500732
